senses.en: to enjoy greatly; to look forward to eagerly
great enjoyment
a chopped pickle sauce eaten with food

ex.en: She seemed to relish the chance to prove her critics wrong.
ex.zh: 她似乎很享受證明批評者錯了的機會。

root.note: 吃完後留下的餘味 → 滋味、享受

senses.en: unwillingness to do something

ex.en: He agreed to help, but his reluctance was obvious.
ex.zh: 他答應幫忙，但明顯很不情願。

root.note: 掙扎著抗拒 → 不情願

senses.en: unwilling and hesitant

ex.en: Many residents were reluctant to leave their homes before the storm.
ex.zh: 很多居民在暴風雨來臨前都不願離開家。

root.note: 掙扎著抗拒 → 不情願的

senses.en: the act of remembering, especially honoring the dead
a memory or a keepsake

ex.en: The town holds a ceremony of remembrance every November.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮每年十一月都會舉行紀念儀式。

root.note: 再次放在心上 → 紀念

senses.en: a story or act of recalling past experiences

ex.en: Her reminiscence about summers on the farm made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 她講起在農場度過的夏天，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

root.note: 再次想起 → 回憶

senses.en: tending to remind one of something
senses.zh: 令人想起…的；使人聯想到的

ex.en: The smell of the bakery was reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 麵包店的香味讓我想起奶奶的廚房。

root.note: 讓人再次想起 → 令人聯想的

mn: 常用片語 be reminiscent of（讓人想起…）。

senses.en: careless in performing one's duty

ex.en: It would be remiss of me not to thank everyone who helped.
ex.zh: 如果我不感謝每位幫忙的人，那就太失禮了。

root.note: 放鬆、放手不管 → 疏忽的

senses.en: a period in which a disease becomes less severe
the canceling of a debt, charge, or penalty

ex.en: After a year of treatment, her cancer went into remission.
ex.zh: 經過一年的治療，她的癌症進入緩解期。

root.note: 放鬆、放掉 → 緩解、免除

senses.en: to change the structure or form of something, especially a building

ex.en: We plan to remodel the kitchen next spring.
ex.zh: 我們打算明年春天改造廚房。

root.note: 重新塑造形式 → 改建

senses.en: a forceful protest or complaint

ex.en: The villagers sent a formal remonstrance to the governor about the new tax.
ex.zh: 村民針對新稅正式向總督提出抗議。

root.note: 反覆指出錯誤 → 抗議、諫言

senses.en: expressing protest or objection
a person who protests

ex.en: The committee ignored every remonstrant letter from the parents.
ex.zh: 委員會對家長們寄來的每一封抗議信都置之不理。

root.note: 反覆指出錯誤的（人）→ 抗議的

senses.en: to make a forcefully reproachful protest

ex.en: She tried to remonstrate with the referee, but he would not listen.
ex.zh: 她試著向裁判抗議，但他不肯聽。

root.note: 一再指出對方的錯 → 抗議、規勸

senses.en: to pay someone for work or services

ex.en: The company will remunerate volunteers for their travel expenses.
ex.zh: 公司會補償志工的交通費。

root.note: 回贈禮物 → 酬謝

senses.en: money paid for work or a service

ex.en: The job offers generous remuneration and flexible hours.
ex.zh: 這份工作待遇優渥，而且工時彈性。

root.note: 回贈的禮物 → 報酬

senses.en: the revival of art and learning in Europe from the 14th to 16th century
(renaissance) a revival of interest or activity

ex.en: Florence was the heart of the Italian Renaissance.
ex.zh: 佛羅倫斯是義大利文藝復興的中心。

root.note: 再次誕生 → 文藝復興

mn: Renaissance man 指多才多藝的通才。

senses.en: a meeting at an agreed time and place
to meet at an agreed time and place

ex.en: The two teams agreed on a rendezvous at the bridge at noon.
ex.zh: 兩隊約定中午在橋邊會合。

root.note: 法文「請你們到場」→ 約定會面

mn: 來自法文，最後的 s 和 z 都不發音。

senses.en: a performance or interpretation of a song, role, or work
a translation

ex.en: Her rendition of the national anthem brought the crowd to tears.
ex.zh: 她演唱的國歌讓全場觀眾感動落淚。

root.note: 把作品重新「交出來」→ 演繹

senses.en: to restore something old to good condition

ex.en: The city plans to renovate the old train station.
ex.zh: 市政府打算整修舊火車站。

root.note: 使再變新 → 翻新

senses.en: the formal giving up of a claim, right, or belief

ex.en: His renunciation of the throne shocked the entire nation.
ex.zh: 他放棄王位的決定震驚了全國。

root.note: 宣告收回 → 放棄

senses.en: to change the way something is organized

ex.en: The new manager decided to reorganize the entire sales team.
ex.zh: 新經理決定重組整個業務團隊。

root.note: 再組織一次 → 重組

senses.en: able to be repaired or set right

ex.en: Fortunately, the damage to the old bridge is reparable.
ex.zh: 幸好這座老橋的損壞是可以修復的。

root.note: 可以再準備好 → 可修補的

mn: 重音在第一音節 RE-parable，和 repair 不一樣；反義字 irreparable 較常見。

senses.en: making amends for a wrong by paying money or helping
(reparations) compensation paid by a defeated nation after war

ex.en: The company offered reparation to families harmed by the chemical spill.
ex.zh: 公司對因化學物質外洩而受害的家庭提出賠償。

root.note: 把損壞的再弄好 → 賠償

senses.en: quick, witty conversation or replies

ex.en: The talk show host was famous for her clever repartee with guests.
ex.zh: 那位脫口秀主持人以和來賓機智對答聞名。

parts.m: set out 出發（法文 partir）

root.note: 立刻回擊 → 機智的應答

senses.en: to officially cancel a law
the act of canceling a law

ex.en: Protesters urged lawmakers to repeal the unpopular tax.
ex.zh: 抗議者敦促立法者廢除這項不得人心的稅。

root.note: 把（法令）叫回來 → 撤銷

senses.en: to drive or force back
to cause disgust in
(of a substance) to resist mixing with

ex.en: This special coating can repel water and dirt.
ex.zh: 這種特殊塗層能防水防污。

root.note: 往回推 → 擊退

senses.en: a substance that keeps insects or water away
causing strong dislike; disgusting

ex.en: Don't forget to bring mosquito repellent on the camping trip.
ex.zh: 去露營別忘了帶防蚊液。

root.note: 把東西趕回去的 → 驅除劑、令人反感

senses.en: sincere regret for wrongdoing

ex.en: The prisoner showed genuine repentance for his crimes.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯對自己的罪行表現出真誠的悔意。

root.note: 深深後悔 → 懺悔

senses.en: a theater company that performs a series of works in rotation
a stock of works that a performer knows; repertoire

ex.en: She got her start as an actress in a small repertory theater.
ex.zh: 她在一家小型定目劇團開始了演員生涯。

root.note: 可以再找出來的清單 → 劇目庫

senses.en: the act of repeating something

ex.en: Learning a language takes a lot of repetition.
ex.zh: 學語言需要大量反覆練習。

root.note: 再去做一次 → 重複

senses.en: to feel or express discontent; to fret

ex.en: There is no use to repine over chances you have already missed.
ex.zh: 為已經錯過的機會抱怨是沒有用的。

root.note: 一再憔悴難過 → 抱怨不滿

senses.en: to fill something up again

ex.en: Drink plenty of water to replenish the fluids you lost while running.
ex.zh: 多喝水，補充跑步時流失的水分。

root.note: 使再滿 → 補充

senses.en: filled or well supplied with something
very full of food

ex.en: The novel is replete with memorable characters.
ex.zh: 這本小說裡充滿令人難忘的角色。

root.note: 填得滿滿的 → 充滿的

mn: 常用片語 be replete with（充滿…）。

senses.en: an exact copy or model of something

ex.en: The museum displays a full-size replica of a dinosaur skeleton.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了一副等比例的恐龍骨骼複製品。

root.note: 摺回去重做一份 → 複製品

senses.en: a place where things are stored
a person or thing full of information

ex.en: The library serves as a repository for rare manuscripts.
ex.zh: 這座圖書館是珍貴手稿的收藏處。

root.note: 把東西放回去的地方 → 存放處

senses.en: to criticize or blame sharply

ex.en: The judge did not hesitate to reprehend the lawyer's rude behavior.
ex.zh: 法官毫不猶豫地斥責那位律師的無禮行為。

root.note: 把人抓回來 → 斥責

senses.en: deserving strong criticism

ex.en: Cheating on the exam was reprehensible behavior.
ex.zh: 考試作弊是應受譴責的行為。

root.note: 應該被抓回來責罵的 → 應受譴責的

senses.en: the act of criticizing or blaming

ex.en: His careless remark drew sharp reprehension from the audience.
ex.zh: 他輕率的言論引來觀眾嚴厲指責。

root.note: 抓回來責罵 → 譴責

senses.en: to hold back a feeling or reaction
to control people by force

ex.en: She tried to repress a smile when the teacher tripped.
ex.zh: 老師絆了一下，她努力忍住不笑。

root.note: 壓回去 → 壓抑、鎮壓

senses.en: able to be held back or controlled

ex.en: Her laughter was barely repressible during the serious speech.
ex.zh: 在那場嚴肅的演講中，她幾乎忍不住笑出來。

root.note: 可以被壓回去的 → 可抑制的

mn: 反義字 irrepressible（壓抑不住的）比較常見。

senses.en: a cancellation or delay of a punishment
a temporary relief from something unpleasant
to cancel or postpone a punishment

ex.en: The rain gave farmers a brief reprieve from the drought.
ex.zh: 這場雨讓農民暫時擺脫了乾旱。

root.note: 把判決拿回來 → 暫緩執行

senses.en: to criticize someone formally
a formal expression of disapproval

ex.en: The coach had to reprimand the player for arriving late.
ex.zh: 教練不得不訓斥那名遲到的球員。

root.note: 應被壓下去的事 → 訓斥

senses.en: an act of retaliation

ex.en: Workers were afraid to report the problem for fear of reprisal.
ex.zh: 員工害怕遭到報復，不敢舉報問題。

root.note: 把東西搶回來 → 報復

senses.en: an unprincipled person
morally bad; unprincipled

ex.en: In the movie, the charming reprobate eventually changes his ways.
ex.zh: 電影裡那個迷人的浪子最後改過自新。

root.note: 不被認可的 → 墮落的人

senses.en: to produce a copy of
to produce offspring

ex.en: Other scientists were unable to reproduce the results of the experiment.
ex.zh: 其他科學家無法重現這項實驗的結果。

root.note: 再產出一次 → 複製、繁殖

senses.en: the process of producing offspring
a copy of a work of art

ex.en: Frogs rely on water for reproduction.
ex.zh: 青蛙靠水來繁殖。

root.note: 再產出 → 繁殖、複製

senses.en: an expression of blame or disapproval

ex.en: The mother's gentle reproof made the child apologize.
ex.zh: 媽媽溫和的責備讓孩子道了歉。

root.note: 反證對方有錯 → 責備

mn: reproof 是名詞，動詞是 reprove（責備）。

senses.en: to refuse to accept or be associated with
senses.zh: 否認；拒絕接受；斷絕關係

ex.en: The candidate was quick to repudiate the offensive comments made by his supporter.
ex.zh: 那位候選人很快就撇清與支持者冒犯性言論的關係。

root.note: 引以為恥而推開 → 否認、拒絕

senses.en: intense disgust

ex.en: She could not hide her repugnance at the cruelty toward the animals.
ex.zh: 她無法掩飾對虐待動物的厭惡。

root.note: 想要對抗的感覺 → 厭惡

senses.en: extremely distasteful; unacceptable

ex.en: Many people find the idea of eating insects repugnant.
ex.zh: 很多人覺得吃昆蟲這個想法很噁心。

root.note: 讓人想反擊的 → 令人厭惡的

senses.en: to drive back an attack
to cause intense disgust in
to reject rudely

ex.en: The soldiers managed to repulse the enemy attack.
ex.zh: 士兵們成功擊退了敵人的攻擊。

root.note: 推回去 → 擊退

senses.en: causing strong dislike or disgust

ex.en: The smell from the garbage truck was absolutely repulsive.
ex.zh: 垃圾車傳來的味道真的非常噁心。

root.note: 讓人想推開的 → 令人厭惡的

senses.en: the opinion generally held of someone; reputation
(be reputed) to be generally believed

ex.en: She is a doctor of great repute in the medical community.
ex.zh: 她是醫學界享有盛名的醫師。

root.note: 大家反覆認為的 → 名聲

senses.en: a Mass or musical piece for the dead

ex.en: The choir performed a requiem in memory of the victims.
ex.zh: 合唱團演唱安魂曲，悼念罹難者。

root.note: 彌撒開頭的拉丁文「願他們安息」→ 安魂曲

senses.en: required for a particular purpose
a thing that is necessary

ex.en: She lacked the requisite experience for the manager position.
ex.zh: 她缺乏擔任經理職位所需的經驗。

root.note: 被要求的 → 必需的

senses.en: a return for a kindness or a wrong; repayment

ex.en: He expected no requital for the help he gave his neighbors.
ex.zh: 他幫助鄰居，從不期待任何回報。

root.note: 回頭清償 → 報答或報復

senses.en: to return a favor or feeling
to take revenge for

ex.en: She loved him deeply, but he did not requite her feelings.
ex.zh: 她深愛著他，但他並沒有回應她的感情。

root.note: 回頭清償 → 回報

mn: unrequited love 是「單戀、得不到回應的愛」。

senses.en: to cancel a law, order, or agreement

ex.en: The university decided to rescind the offer after learning he had lied.
ex.zh: 大學得知他說謊後，決定撤銷錄取。

root.note: 切斷收回 → 撤銷

senses.en: to seat again or in a different place
to fit a part back into its correct position

ex.en: The usher had to reseat the family because of a ticket mix-up.
ex.zh: 因為票弄錯了，帶位員只好幫那家人換座位。

root.note: 再安排座位

senses.en: the state of looking or being alike

ex.en: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 這對姊妹長得很像。

root.note: 很相似 → 相像

senses.en: to feel bitterness about something unfair

ex.en: Many employees resent having to work on weekends without extra pay.
ex.zh: 很多員工對週末加班卻沒有加班費感到不滿。

root.note: 強烈地感受（不滿）→ 怨恨

senses.en: a large natural or artificial lake used to store water
a large supply of something

ex.en: The reservoir is almost empty after months without rain.
ex.zh: 好幾個月沒下雨，水庫幾乎乾了。

root.note: 保存東西的地方 → 水庫、儲藏

senses.en: a small amount of something that remains

ex.en: Wash the fruit to remove any pesticide residue.
ex.zh: 把水果洗乾淨，去除農藥殘留。

root.note: 坐著留在後面的 → 殘留物

senses.en: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties
the ability of a material to spring back into shape

ex.en: The community showed remarkable resilience after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後，這個社區展現出驚人的韌性。

root.note: 跳回原狀 → 韌性、彈性

senses.en: able to recover quickly from difficulties
senses.zh: 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的

senses.en: able to spring back into shape

ex.en: Children are often more resilient than adults expect.
ex.zh: 孩子往往比大人以為的更有韌性。

root.note: 能跳回原狀的 → 有韌性的

senses.en: the refusal to accept or comply with something
the ability not to be affected by something
the degree to which a material opposes electric current

ex.en: The new policy met strong resistance from teachers.
ex.zh: 新政策遭到老師們強烈反對。

root.note: 站著對抗 → 抵抗

senses.en: not affected or harmed by something
opposed to something

ex.en: Some bacteria have become resistant to common antibiotics.
ex.zh: 有些細菌已經對常見的抗生素產生抗藥性。

root.note: 站著對抗的 → 抵抗的

senses.en: tending to resist; relating to electrical resistance

ex.en: Older phones used a resistive touch screen that needed firm pressure.
ex.zh: 舊型手機用的是電阻式觸控螢幕，要用力按才有反應。

root.note: 具有對抗性質的 → 電阻的

senses.en: impossible to resist; irresistible
offering no resistance

ex.en: The river swept everything away with resistless force.
ex.zh: 河水以不可抗拒的力量把一切沖走。

root.note: 無法抵抗的

senses.en: a deep, full, reverberating quality of sound
the power to evoke feelings or memories

ex.en: The story has special resonance for anyone who grew up in a small town.
ex.zh: 對在小鎮長大的人來說，這個故事特別能引起共鳴。

root.note: 聲音再次響起 → 共鳴

senses.en: to produce a deep, full, echoing sound
to evoke a feeling of shared emotion or belief

ex.en: Her speech about hard work seemed to resonate with the students.
ex.zh: 她關於努力的演講似乎引起了學生的共鳴。

root.note: 聲音再次響起 → 共鳴

senses.en: a supply of money, materials, or staff that can be used
something that provides help or information

ex.en: Water is a precious resource in desert regions.
ex.zh: 在沙漠地區，水是珍貴的資源。

root.note: 不斷湧出的來源 → 資源

senses.en: a short period of rest or relief from something difficult

ex.en: The cool breeze offered a brief respite from the summer heat.
ex.zh: 涼爽的微風讓人暫時擺脫夏天的炎熱。

root.note: 回頭看一下、停一停 → 喘息

mn: 發音是 RES-pit，不要唸成 re-SPITE。

senses.en: impressive through being richly colorful or dazzling

ex.en: The bride looked resplendent in her silk gown.
ex.zh: 新娘穿著絲綢禮服，光彩奪目。

root.note: 閃閃發亮 → 燦爛的（splendid 同源）

senses.en: a person who answers a survey or questionnaire
a defendant in a lawsuit, especially in an appeal or divorce

ex.en: Each respondent was asked to rate the product from one to ten.
ex.zh: 每位受訪者都被要求為產品打一到十分。

root.note: 回應的人 → 受訪者

senses.en: the return of something lost or stolen to its owner
payment for injury or loss

ex.en: The court ordered him to pay restitution to the victims.
ex.zh: 法院命令他賠償受害者。

parts.m: set up, place 設立、放置

root.note: 放回原處 → 歸還、賠償

senses.en: the act of beginning something again after a pause

ex.en: Both sides welcomed the resumption of peace talks.
ex.zh: 雙方都歡迎和談重新展開。

root.note: 再拿起來 → 恢復

senses.en: rising again; increasing after a period of little activity

ex.en: The resurgent economy created thousands of new jobs.
ex.zh: 復甦的經濟創造了數千個新工作機會。

root.note: 再次升起的 → 復甦的

senses.en: the act of rising from the dead
the revival of something that had disappeared

ex.en: The band's reunion tour marked the resurrection of their career.
ex.zh: 這個樂團的重聚巡演標誌著他們事業的重生。

root.note: 再次站起來 → 復活

senses.en: to revive someone from unconsciousness or apparent death
to make something active or successful again

ex.en: Paramedics worked for twenty minutes to resuscitate the swimmer.
ex.zh: 急救人員花了二十分鐘搶救那名泳客。

root.note: 再次喚醒 → 使甦醒

senses.en: to attack or harm someone in return

ex.en: The country threatened to retaliate with higher tariffs.
ex.zh: 該國揚言要以提高關稅作為報復。

parts.m: such, like 同樣的（拉丁文 talis）

root.note: 以同樣方式回敬 → 報復

senses.en: to make the sound and movement of vomiting

ex.en: The terrible smell made him retch.
ex.zh: 那股可怕的味道讓他乾嘔。

mn: 發音同 wretch（可憐的人），但意思完全不同。

senses.en: the continued keeping or holding of something
the ability to remember things

ex.en: The company offered bonuses to improve employee retention.
ex.zh: 公司提供獎金來提高員工留任率。

root.note: 留住不放 → 保留

senses.en: the quality of not revealing one's thoughts or feelings

ex.en: His reticence about his personal life made him seem mysterious.
ex.zh: 他對私生活的沉默寡言讓他顯得很神祕。

root.note: 一直保持沉默 → 沉默寡言

senses.en: a group of assistants or servants accompanying an important person

ex.en: The pop star arrived with a retinue of bodyguards and assistants.
ex.zh: 那位流行歌手帶著一群保鑣和助理抵達。

root.note: 被留在身邊的人 → 隨從

senses.en: to reply quickly in a sharp or witty way
a sharp or witty reply

ex.en: "That's none of your business," she was quick to retort.
ex.zh: 「這不關你的事。」她立刻回嘴。

root.note: 把話扭回去 → 反駁

senses.en: to improve a photo or painting by making small changes

ex.en: The magazine promised not to retouch photos of its models.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌承諾不會修改模特兒的照片。

root.note: 再加幾筆 → 修飾

senses.en: to go back over the same route
to trace something back to its origin

ex.en: I had to retrace my steps to find my lost keys.
ex.zh: 我只好沿著原路走回去找我掉的鑰匙。

root.note: 沿著足跡回去 → 折回、追溯

senses.en: to withdraw a statement or accusation
to draw something back in

ex.en: The newspaper had to retract the story after it proved false.
ex.zh: 那則報導被證實是假的之後，報社只好撤回。

root.note: 拉回來 → 撤回、縮回

senses.en: to reduce costs or spending

ex.en: Falling sales forced the company to retrench.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑迫使公司緊縮開支。

root.note: 把花費切掉 → 削減

senses.en: to get or bring something back
to find and extract stored information

ex.en: I went back to the office to retrieve my laptop.
ex.zh: 我回辦公室去拿我的筆電。

root.note: 再找到 → 取回

mn: retriever（尋回犬）就是幫獵人把獵物叼回來的狗。

senses.en: taking effect from a date in the past
senses.zh: 追溯既往的；溯及既往的

ex.en: The pay raise is retroactive to January first.
ex.zh: 這次加薪從一月一日起追溯生效。

root.note: 往回作用的 → 追溯既往的

senses.en: moving backward; returning to a worse state
(of a planet) appearing to move backward

ex.en: Critics called the new law a retrograde step for women's rights.
ex.zh: 批評者稱這項新法是女權的倒退。

root.note: 往後退步 → 倒退的

senses.en: the process of returning to an earlier or worse state

ex.en: The war caused a retrogression in the country's economic development.
ex.zh: 戰爭讓該國的經濟發展倒退。

root.note: 往後走 → 倒退

senses.en: a review of past events

ex.en: In retrospect, I should have studied harder for the test.
ex.zh: 回想起來，我當時應該更用功準備考試。

root.note: 往後看 → 回顧

mn: 最常用片語 in retrospect（回想起來）。

senses.en: looking back on past events
an exhibition showing an artist's work over a long period

ex.en: The museum is holding a retrospective of the painter's work.
ex.zh: 博物館正在舉辦這位畫家的作品回顧展。

root.note: 往後看的 → 回顧的

senses.en: to come together or bring together again after separation

ex.en: The rescue workers helped reunite the lost child with her parents.
ex.zh: 救援人員幫助迷路的孩子與父母團聚。

root.note: 再次合而為一 → 重聚

senses.en: a surprising fact that is made known
something surprisingly good or impressive
a divine or supernatural disclosure

ex.en: The revelation that he had lied shocked his friends.
ex.zh: 他說謊的事被揭穿，讓朋友們震驚不已。

root.note: 揭開面紗 → 揭露

senses.en: to feel deep respect or admiration for

ex.en: Many scientists revere Marie Curie for her groundbreaking work.
ex.zh: 許多科學家崇敬居禮夫人的開創性研究。

parts.m: fear, respect 敬畏（拉丁文 vereri）

root.note: 深深敬畏 → 崇敬

senses.en: feeling or showing deep respect

ex.en: The crowd fell into a reverent silence as the ceremony began.
ex.zh: 儀式開始時，群眾恭敬地安靜下來。

root.note: 充滿敬畏的 → 恭敬的

senses.en: a return to a previous state or practice
the return of property to a former owner

ex.en: The team's poor play was a reversion to their old bad habits.
ex.zh: 球隊表現不佳是因為又回到了過去的壞習慣。

root.note: 轉回原狀 → 回復
